_comment: EDITABLE EXAMPLE. This is Librarian's neutral default taxonomy. It ships with a generic, investigation-neutral content-type vocabulary so a fresh install produces sane notes with zero configuration. Domain-specific vocabularies are USER OVERRIDES, not shipped values: copy this file to taxonomy.json and replace `content_types`, `tag_order`, `folder_conventions.folder_map`, etc. with your own. No domain-specific strings (place names, vendor names, subject-matter tags) belong in this shipped example, which is enforced by a neutrality test over this file's text. Per references/prior-art.md Coupling 3, the classify agent and skills/librarian/SKILL.md READ these values instead of hardcoding an enum; partial overrides are merged over these defaults by scripts/taxonomy.py load_taxonomy().
